name: Halloween Connect
author: Addicting Games
description: Halloween Connect is a Halloween-themed matching game perfect for a relaxing game session. Enjoy this eerie-inspired game with backgrounds full of spooky and haunted forests that are infested with bats, ghosts, and Jack O’ Lanterns. This is a game for fans of matching tiles and everything Halloween. Match together tiles that picture monsters and other scary characters or items. There are witches’ hats, coffins, skulls, bats, red shot eyeballs, and spiders. From creepy to scary, there’s everything you love about Halloween. There are 10 levels of Halloween matching games for you to solve today. Once you’ve beaten every level, click on the high scores to see if you’re the best matching game player on AddictingGames.
